'''Cryptosis''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Village Plaza}}. They sell "BZT" in exchange for {{Item|Scribe Crux|amount=15}}es and {{Motes|15,000}}, which grants the player an {{Item|Enigma Soul}} when purchased.

== Interface ==
{{/UI}}

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Condition
! Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | First interaction
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: What's a &bBZT&f, you ask?
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: Well everyone is talking about them, so you should know, bro!
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: &bBZT &fis immutable digital ownership!
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: Each one of them are unique and because they're unique, they're super &9rare&f!
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: You can also &ecollect &fthem!
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: There's a bunch of a different collections, depending on your tastes!
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: And you can always &6resell &fthem! Everyone is trading &bBZTs&f!
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: Think about it, they're so &9rare&f, a &ecollector &fwill snatch it from you for BIG &6coins&f!
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: What are you waiting for?
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: Limited time only!
}}
|-
| class="ct" | Before buying BZT
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: Bro I would totally give you the pitch again but I'm busy picking my next car!
}}
|-
| class="ct" | Buying BZT
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Cryptosis&f: Aaaaand it's gone!
&aYou bought &bBuy a unique BZT!&a!
&7&oIt might have been a scam...
&7&oIf something seems too good to be true... maybe it is.
&7&oYou find an Enigma Soul from exploring your inner self!

|}

'''Julian''' is an [[NPC]] in the {{Zone|Oubliette}}. They talk about how they are looking for Precursors.

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Condition
! Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | None
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: If you've made it this far, you're &otalented&f.
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: Me?
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: I'm trying to solve one of the &9deepest mysteries &fof our world.
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: I'm looking for traces of the &4Precursors&f, but there's none anywhere.
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: Zip!
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: Nada!
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: Not even anywhere in the &dRift&f!
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: If they're trying to return to &aour world &fone day, shouldn't &4they &fcome through &dhere&f?
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: &eOruo &fisn't even here.
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: But I know for a fact he acquired the &dBlessing of Time &fright here, in the &cChâteau&f!
&e[NPC] &2Julian&f: So many questions left unanswered...
}}
|}

== Trivia ==
*[[Elise (Rift)|Elise]] says the following dialogue about '''Julian''': {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &dElise&f: Have you encountered &2Julian&f?
&e[NPC] &dElise&f: He's been spotted in the &dRift &fon several occasions.
&e[NPC] &dElise&f: While he may seem &afriendly&f, be &ccautious&f.
&e[NPC] &dElise&f: Those in his organization have committed &oquestionable &facts.
&e[NPC] &dElise&f: One doesn't reach &2his &frank without &ccrossing a few lines&f.
}}
*'''Julian''' is one of a few NPCs who do not originate from the [[Rift Dimension]], alongside {{NPCSprite|Dr. Emmett}}, {{NPCSprite|Barry}}, {{NPCSprite|Alatar}} and {{NPCSprite|Tel Kar}}.
*Based on his appearance, he may come from {{Zone|Scarleton}} in the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}.
*'''Julian''' is mentioned by {{NPCSprite|Shen Magnum Opus;Shen Magnum Opus'}} in their dialogue, along with {{NPCSprite|Maeve}} and Seth.

'''Liz''' is an [[NPC]] in the {{zone|Trade Center}} that sells various items in exchange for {{Item|Stock of Stonks}} while {{NPCSprite|Diaz}} is in office with the Stock Exchange perk.

== Interface ==
{{/UI}}

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | When Diaz is not in office
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Liz&f: Welcome to the &bTrade Center&f!
&e[NPC] Liz&f: Sorry, but there's... not much to see here right now.
&e[NPC] Liz&f: We're friends of &6Diaz&f's, so we only really have stuff to do when she's elected as &6Mayor&f, haha.
&e[NPC] Liz&f: Try dropping by when she's in office!
}}
|-
| class="ct" | First Interaction when Diaz is in office
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Liz&f: &aRichard &fthinks he's it, being the &dStonks Auction &fManager.
&e[NPC] Liz&f: &7&oJerk&7.
&e[NPC] Liz&f: If not for me and my &ashop&f, people wouldn't even &c&oCARE &fabout &5Stock of Stonks&f.
&e[NPC] Liz&f: Yup, that's right - you can trade me &5Stock of Stonks &ffor some &dspecial items&f.
&e[NPC] Liz&f: Most of them are &aCrafting materials &fused to upgrade various &6Coin&f-related pieces of gear.
&e[NPC] Liz&f: Better hurry, though because they're only available during &6Mayor Diaz&f's term.
&e[NPC] Liz&f: Here's what I've got.
}}
|}

== Trivia ==
*Excluding {{Item|Golden Bounty}}, utilizing all of '''Liz'''<nowiki />'s products to max potential requires {{Item|Stock of Stonks|amount=338|text=Stocks of Stonk}}.
**Total of {{Item|Stock of Stonks|amount=116|text=Stocks of Stonk}} are required to get {{Item|Freshly-Minted Coins}} for both {{Item|Relic of Coins}} and {{Item|Scavenger Artifact}}. 
**Additional {{Item|Stock of Stonks|amount=72|text=Stocks of Stonk}} are required to upgrade all items using {{Item|Golden Fragment}}s. 
**And {{Item|Stock of Stonks|amount=150|text=Stocks of Stonk}} are required for both {{Item|Crown of Avarice}} and {{Item|Emerald Artifact}}.
*According to the person who came up with the idea of {{Zone|Trade Center}} and {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}'s "Long Term Investment" perk, '''Liz''' is [[Diaz]]'s sister.<ref>https://hypixel.net/threads/in-honor-of-diaz-getting-elected.5709602/page-2#post-39909768</ref>

'''Maddox the Slayer''' is an [[NPC]] located at the {{Zone|Stillgore Chateau}} in the [[Rift Dimension|Rift]]. The player can start a [[Slayer]] quest after speaking to '''Maddox the Slayer''' and paying {{Motes}}. The player can access '''Maddox the Slayer''' from anywhere within the [[Rift Dimension|Rift]] by using the {{Item|Maddox Badphone}} once reaching {{CollectionLink|Vampire Slayer II}}.

== Interface ==
{{/UI}}

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | Before showing a {{Item|Healing Melon}}
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: I'm not letting &bmagic&f, &ddimensions&f, or the arrest of &6time &fstop me from grinding.
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: If there's something to slay, I show up no matter what.
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: Today, &4vampires &rare on the menu.
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: Be careful because they deal &c❤ &rdamage and if you &4die &raround here...
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: ... believe it or not, right to &cjail&r.
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: So you need to &aheal&r!
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: With &amelons&r!
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: Slay a few vampires, then craft and show me your &aHealing Melon&r!
}}
|-
| class="ct" | Showing a {{Item|Healing Melon}}
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: Very good.
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: Now let's get down to business.
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: &fI'm not letting &bmagic&f, &dinter-dimensional travel&f, or the arrest of &6time &fstop me from grinding.
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: &fDay, night, &5tenebrous void&f...
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: &fDon't care!
&e[NPC] &5Maddox the Slayer&f: &fI show up anyway!
}}
|}

== Trivia ==
*'''Maddox's''' dialogue regarding inter-dimensional travel implies both {{NPCSprite|Maddox the Slayer (Rift);'''Maddox the Slayer'''}} and his hub's counterpart {{NPCSprite|Maddox}} are the same entity. 
**This is makes {{NPCSprite|Maddox the Slayer (Rift);'''Maddox the Slayer'''}} one of the few [[NPC]]'s able to traverse between the [[Rift Dimension|Rift]] and the [[SkyBlock|Overworld]].
*'''Maddox's''' dialogue "... believe it or not, right to jail." is a reference to the iconic "Right to Jail"<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eiyfwZVAzGw</ref> monologue in Parks and Recreation Season 2 Episode 5 titled Sister City.<ref>https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1504148/</ref>
